refusal.signOutside: An assignment or an exclusive licence cannot be signed in the app. Reopen the terms, or sign outside the platform.
refusal.paymentMismatch: That amount does not match what the organisation recorded. Nothing was confirmed: talk to the organisation about the difference.
refusal.invalid: Some details were not accepted. Check the form and try again.
refusal.invalidContactBy: Choose a contact-by date from today, no more than five business days ahead.
refusal.attestation: Give the date the internal work started and confirm the statement.
refusal.reasonText: Explain the reason in more detail.
refusal.notFound: This engagement is no longer available to you.
refusal.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

stepUp.body: Confirm with the code from your authenticator app to continue.
stepUp.invalid: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.notEnrolled: This step needs two-step sign-in. Turn it on, then come back to this engagement.

form.amount: Enter an amount in shillings, for example 250000.
form.days: Enter a number of days, for example 5.

approve.lead: Name who will contact the developer, how, and by when. The developer's contact details are shared with that person.
approve.byHint: No more than five business days from today.

decline.lead: The developer sees the reason you choose.
decline.otherHint: A few sentences the developer will read.
decline.started: When did the internal work start?
decline.attest: We confirm this work was already in progress inside our organisation before we saw this proposal.
decline.attestRequired: Confirm the statement to use this reason.

terms.lead: A new version of the terms. The other party marks it final before either side signs.
terms.ipHint: An assignment or an exclusive licence is signed outside the platform.
terms.deemedHint: Days after a milestone is submitted until it counts as accepted without a response. 0 means never.
terms.windowHint: Leave empty for the standard window.

payment.lead: Record the final payment your organisation made. The developer confirms what arrived; the platform never holds or moves money.
payment.referenceHint: For example the M-Pesa confirmation code.

confirmPayment.lead: Enter the amount that reached you. It must match what the organisation recorded.

contact.name: Name
contact.noEmail: The developer has no verified email address yet.
